theater: 彭城至壽陽的淮北戰線

battle.name: 侯景叛東魏之戰
battle.theater: 彭城至壽陽的淮北戰線
battle.brief: 公元547年秋，東魏河南大行台侯景舉兵反，遣使降梁，圍攻彭城；渤海王高澄親率大軍討之，追至寒山，大破景軍，景僅以數十騎遁保壽陽，兩軍議和罷兵。卡面的希臘重步兵是對照件：本役真正交鋒的是披甲騎兵、弩手與攻城器械，與希臘方陣無涉，它提醒的正是方陣一旦失去互相遮蔽便立刻崩散。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 這場叛亂的交戰方只有兩個政權，但每一邊內部都不是單一軍隊。東魏一方是北魏孝武帝西遷之後、由渤海王高歡把持軍政的體系，名義上的皇帝在都城鄴城，實際的兵權與人事都握在高氏父子手中；高歡為東魏大將軍兼錄尚書事，軍令直接從鄴城的高府發出，州鎮的鎮兵、軍士與客軍多由其家臣與姻親分遣。侯景出事前任河南道行台，統率黃河以南、淮水以北的豫州軍政，麾下主力是六鎮出身的邊軍與編入東魏戶籍的降戶，漢胡混編而以騎兵見長；這支部隊既是他叛亂的底子，也是東魏在短期內無法完全接替的缺口。梁一方是梁武帝蕭衍在建康的中樞，軍事上靠宗室與州鎮將領分頭出兵；侯景降梁後，梁廷以侯景為將軍兼尚書令，令其仍據河南，並另遣汝南王蕭淵明率眾北上，名義上協同作戰，實際上互不統屬。背景裡還有第三股力量：河北六鎮降戶與河南豪右，侯景叛亂能成，靠的就是這一層地方武力的支持與掩護。
countriesEn: Only two polities fought in this rebellion, but neither side was a single army. The Eastern Wei side was the regime that the Prince of Bohai, Gao Huan, had taken over after Emperor Xiaowu of Northern Wei moved west; the emperor nominally sat in the capital at Ye, but the real command of troops and appointments lay with the Gao family. Gao Huan was Grand General of Eastern Wei and Director of the Department of State Affairs, and orders went out directly from his residence in Ye, with the garrison troops, military households and guest forces of the prefectures and commanderies distributed among his kinsmen and family retainers. Before his rebellion Hou Jing was Director of the Henan Circuit, governing the military and civil administration of Yuzhou between the Yellow River and the Huai, and his main force consisted of frontier soldiers from the Six Garrisons together with surrendered households enrolled in Eastern Wei's registers, a mixed Chinese and Xianbei force known for its cavalry. That force was both the base of his rebellion and a gap that Eastern Wei could not quickly fill. The Liang side was the central government of Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan, at Jiankang, which fought through princes of the imperial clan and provincial commanders. After Hou Jing submitted, the Liang court made him General and Director of the Department of State Affairs, left him holding Henan, and separately sent the Prince of Runan, Xiao Yuanming, north with an army to cooperate in appearance but without any unified command. A third force stood in the background: the surrendered households of the Six Garrisons and the local magnates of Henan. The rebellion succeeded precisely because that layer of local military power supported and shielded him.
people: 東魏方面的核心是渤海王高氏父子。高歡生前把河南一路交給侯景，這是胡漢將帥之間沿用多年的信任關係；高歡於547年正月病逝，兒子高澄以尚書令、渤海王的名分接掌軍政，成為侯景最直接的對手。高澄在位不過一年多，卻把這場平叛辦得乾淨：他判定侯景必反，先削其部分兵權，又拒絕侯景求授兗州刺史的要求，侯景於是舉兵；平叛之中他自領大軍出鄴城、親至前線，又命大都督慕容紹宗率精騎追擊侯景，在寒山把景軍打崩，最後進軍壽陽圍城，逼出侯景請和。侯景本人字萬卿，懷朔鎮出身，父侯瑒曾任魏鎮將，戰死於葛榮之亂；他自少年便在北鎮行伍中歷練，靠招集關中、朔方降戶、訓練胡騎起家，是六鎮出身者中少數能獨當一面的大將。梁武帝蕭衍在接到降書後當即納降，是這場戰爭另一個關鍵決定：他封侯景為將軍兼尚書令，另遣汝南王蕭淵明率眾五萬北上，想借侯景在河南的聲勢與梁軍正面配合；蕭淵明與侯景互不統屬，會攻彭城時各自為戰，結果大敗而還，士卒死者以萬計，是梁朝在北方最重的一次挫折。
peopleEn: The Eastern Wei side turned on the father and son of the Prince of Bohai. Gao Huan had entrusted Henan to Hou Jing while alive, and the two were bound by a trust between Chinese and Xianbei commanders that had been in use for years; Gao Huan died of illness in the first month of 547, and his son Gao Cheng, holding the titles Director of the Department of State Affairs and Prince of Bohai, took over military government and became Hou Jing's immediate opponent. Gao Cheng held power for barely more than a year, yet he handled the suppression cleanly: judging that Hou Jing would certainly rebel, he first stripped part of Hou Jing's command, then refused the request for the governorship of Yanzhou, and Hou Jing rose in arms. In the field Gao Cheng led the great army out of Ye in person, brought the fighting to the front, and ordered the General-in-Chief Murong Shaozong to pursue Hou Jing with picked cavalry, breaking his army at Hanshan, before he advanced to Shouyang and besieged it, forcing Hou Jing to ask for terms. Hou Jing himself, courtesy name Wanqing, came from the Huixuo garrison; his father Hou Yang once held a command in Wei and was killed in the rebellion of Ge Rong. From boyhood he served in the ranks of the northern garrisons, rising on the strength of gathering surrendered households from Guanzhong and Shuofang and drilling Xianbei cavalry, and was one of the few men out of the Six Garrisons able to hold a command on his own. The other decisive decision was Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan, who accepted the submission as soon as the letter arrived: he made Hou Jing General and Director of the Department of State Affairs and sent the Prince of Runan, Xiao Yuanming, north with fifty thousand men, hoping to combine Hou Jing's position in Henan with the Liang army in a single advance. Xiao Yuanming and Hou Jing were not under a unified command and fought separately when they moved against Pengcheng; the result was a complete defeat, with losses of troops recorded in the tens of thousands, the heaviest blow the Liang court had taken in the north.
kits: 卡面是希臘重步兵，公元前五世紀的方陣戰士：這不是本役的實物，甚至不是同時代的兵器，它在這場戰爭裡的角色是對照件。實際上陣的是北朝邊軍與梁軍的混合部隊，核心是披甲騎兵與騎射手。侯景麾下多六鎮降戶與關中、朔方流民，馬匹是其立軍之本，東魏與梁在淮北爭的正是能上馬、能縱馬衝陣的兵力；重裝騎兵以鎧甲護身，鎧的形制已從漢晉的札甲逐步轉向與後世明光鎧相近的鐵質胸背具，馬具則以皮製鞍韁為主，無長槊時用短刀與長矛。步兵多為弩手、槊手與長槍手，配圓盾或小盾，射手在陣前成排齊射以擾敵，這是當時最接近「互相遮蔽」的實際做法。攻城方面，雙方用的是雲梯、撞車、擲車與穴地掘進的原始攻城法，彭城與壽陽的守城戰都留下攻具與塹壕對峙的痕跡；糧秣靠河南本地屯積與泗水、淮水沿線的漕運，侯景軍在壽陽的最大問題正是糧食接不上。營務方面採連營與帳幕制，車馬行李隨軍，與希臘方陣那種以重裝步兵互相抵住、拒絕被突破的邏輯，恰是兩種東西。
kitsEn: The card shows a Greek hoplite, a phalanx soldier of the fifth century BC. This is not an artefact of the present war, nor even of the same age; its role here is that of a reference piece. What actually went into the line were mixed northern and southern forces whose core was armoured cavalry and mounted archers. Many of Hou Jing's men were surrendered households from the Six Garrisons and refugees from Guanzhong and Shuofang, and horses were the foundation of his army; the struggle in the Huai valley was fought over exactly how many men could mount up and charge. Armoured riders wore their protection on the body, with the plate moving from the scale and lamellar forms of Han and Jin toward iron cuirasses close to the later mingguang type, and their tack was mainly leather saddle and rein; where the long spear was lacking they used the short sabre and the long lance. The infantry were mostly crossbowmen, spearmen and pikemen, equipped with round or small shields, and the archers fired in ranks from the front of the line, which was the nearest practical equivalent of mutual cover. For siege work both sides used scaling ladders, battering rams, stone-throwing engines and the digging of tunnels; the sieges of Pengcheng and Shouyang both leave traces of siege works faced by ditch and rampart. Supplies came from stores gathered in Henan and from the transport of grain along the Si and Huai waterways, and Hou Jing's gravest problem at Shouyang was that the food did not keep coming. On the camp side the armies used chain encampments and tent lines, with baggage and draught animals on the march, which is a world away from the logic of the Greek phalanx, where heavily armed infantry propped up one another and refused to be broken.
tactics: 侯景的戰術核心是騎兵加圍城。他舉兵時以輕騎先取豫州各縣的倉庫與城邑，控制糧源，再以步卒帶雲梯、撞車與穴道器具攻彭城，把一支本無攻城傳統的邊軍硬生生變成圍城軍，這是他比東魏諸將占上風的地方。東魏的應法是高澄的親征：他不與侯景爭一城一地的得失，而是帶足日用的糧秣直趨彭城，以主力逼其解圍；侯景果然棄城北走，軍隊在退卻中失去隊形，慕容紹宗以精騎追擊，在寒山把潰兵壓入泗水一帶，士卒走散與溺死者甚眾。侯景退保壽陽後，高澄築圍城、修長塹，斷絕城外的樵採與糧道，逼他出來；侯景無法久撐，遣使請和，與紹宗約定相見、彼此罷兵，才換得喘息。這一戰的第三個教訓在梁軍那邊：汝南王蕭淵明的五萬眾北上後與侯景不相統屬，攻彭城時各行其事，既沒有協同的時刻，也沒有共用的糧道，結果被東魏騎兵擊散，士卒死者以萬計，說明當時的會戰仍然靠主將之間的個人默契與同一支後勤在支撐。
tacticsEn: The core of Hou Jing's method was cavalry plus siege. When he rose he sent light horse first to seize the granaries and county seats of Yuzhou, taking control of the food, and only then brought infantry with ladders, rams and tunnelling gear against Pengcheng; a border army with no tradition of siege was turned in this way into a besieging force, and that was where he held the advantage over the Eastern Wei generals. Eastern Wei answered with Gao Cheng's personal command: rather than contesting one town at a time, he marched with a full allowance of days' supplies straight at Pengcheng and put his main force against Hou Jing to force the siege lifted. Hou Jing did indeed abandon the city and move north, and his army lost its order in the withdrawal; Murong Shaozong pursued with picked cavalry and pressed the routed men into the neighbourhood of the Si river at Hanshan, where a great many were drowned or scattered. After Hou Jing shut himself up in Shouyang, Gao Cheng built a besieging enclosure and long ditches, cut the charcoal and grain routes outside the walls, and waited for him to come out. Hou Jing could not hold and sent envoys to ask for terms, coming to an agreement with Shaozong to meet and to disband their forces, which bought him a breathing space. A third lesson lay on the Liang side: the fifty thousand men the Prince of Runan, Xiao Yuanming, took north were not under a unified command with Hou Jing, moved separately against Pengcheng, had no common moment of attack and no common supply line, and were broken up by Eastern Wei cavalry, with losses in the tens of thousands. The fighting of that age still rested on personal coordination between commanders and on a single shared logistics system.
data: 可核的數字不多，且多出自勝方與後世史家的約數。時間線是：東魏武定五年、也就是梁大同十三年，高歡於正月病逝，侯景於同年秋舉兵，戰事跨年，直到次年也就是548年秋天高澄病逝於軍中才告一段落，前後約一年有餘。兵力方面，侯景起兵時所部兵眾以千計，靠裹脅河南郡縣與收編散兵迅速膨脹，據其後被梁軍收編的殘部推算，最盛時不過萬餘人上下；高澄一方是主力，諸史或稱大軍數萬，亦有至十萬之說，當是連同鄴城留守與各州援軍的虛數，實際投入前線的當在萬計。梁軍方面，《梁書》記汝南王蕭淵明率眾五萬北上，兵敗後士卒死者萬餘，這是本役唯一一組明確到「萬」的數字。距離上，彭城到壽陽直線不足二百公里，若順泗水、淮水轉運則五百餘里，一支沒有制水權的騎兵隊伍要靠奪取沿途倉庫維持供給。時間上，壽陽被圍數十日而後議和；攻城器械、壕塹與營壘的工程量在《魏書》《梁書》都只有「築城」「修塹」一類的概括記載，沒有留下可供核算的尺寸。
dataEn: Few numbers can be checked, and most are rough figures from the victors and from later historians. The chronology runs as follows: in the fifth year of Wuding of Eastern Wei, which is the thirteenth year of Datong of Liang, Gao Huan died of illness in the first month, Hou Jing rose in arms in the autumn of the same year, and the war ran across the year into the next, ending only in the autumn of 548 when Gao Cheng died of illness in camp, a span of a little over a year. On strength, the troops Hou Jing had with him when he rose can be counted in thousands; he swelled them rapidly by compelling the counties of Henan to join him and by absorbing scattered bands, and from the remnants later taken over by the Liang army it can be reckoned that his peak was on the order of ten thousand men. Gao Cheng's side was the main force; the histories variously speak of several tens of thousands and even of a hundred thousand, which must include the garrison of Ye and the contingents of the various provinces, so what was actually committed in the front line was on the order of ten thousand. On the Liang side, the History of Liang records that the Prince of Runan, Xiao Yuanming, took north fifty thousand men, and that after the defeat the dead were counted in the tens of thousands; that is the only set of figures in the present war that is as precise as the word ten thousand. In distance, Pengcheng and Shouyang are under two hundred kilometres apart in a straight line, and rather more than five hundred li if the grain is moved by the Si and the Huai, so a cavalry force with no command of the waterways had to live by seizing the depots along the route. In time, Shouyang was besieged for a number of tens of days before terms were agreed; the dimensions of the siege works, ditches and camps survive only as general remarks such as building a town and raising a rampart in the History of Wei and the History of Liang, with nothing that can be calculated.
cause: 起因有三層，每一層都指向同一件事：河南這塊地方，已經不屬於東魏中央。直接導火線是高歡的死亡。547年正月高歡病逝，侯景當時是東魏河南大行台，據黃河以南、淮水以北的豫州，統著一支規模可觀的胡漢邊軍，手中握有兵、糧與城池；高歡在世時，這種分權是平衡同族姻親與外姓將領的常用手法，人之常情。高澄接位後收束權柄：侯景求授兗州刺史不得，又被削去部分兵權並受猜忌，兩人之間原本靠私人信任維繫的關係瞬間斷裂，侯景自度交鋒必敗，遂於同年秋舉兵。第二層是地方動因：侯景起兵前密令河南諸郡響應，六鎮降戶、河南豪右與邊軍久受東魏徵發，本就盼著一場變亂改換旗幟，因此起兵之令一下，郡縣多響應，叛軍不是一支孤軍，而是一場有地方基礎的集體行動。第三層在梁那邊：梁武帝多年北伐不成，正缺一個能撬開河南的內應，侯景的降書一到，蕭衍當即納降、封官遣使，把河南的地盤與侯景的兵眾一併收進自己的計畫裡——這一點在事後看代價極為沉重，但在547年的建康，它看上去像是一份送到手裡的禮物。
causeEn: There are three layers of cause, and each of them points at the same fact: Henan was no longer the Eastern Wei court's to command. The immediate trigger was Gao Huan's death. In the first month of 547 Gao Huan fell ill and died, and Hou Jing at that moment was Director of the Henan Circuit, holding Yuzhou between the Yellow River and the Huai with a sizeable army of Chinese and Xianbei frontier soldiers and with command of men, grain and cities in his own hands. While Gao Huan lived, such a division of authority was the ordinary way of balancing kinsmen and married allies against commanders of other surnames, and there was nothing abnormal in it. Gao Cheng tightened his grip after taking over: Hou Jing's request to be given the Yanzhou governorship was refused, part of his command was taken away, and he was placed under suspicion, and the relationship that had rested on private trust between the two broke at once. Hou Jing judged that once they came into conflict he would lose, and rose in arms in the autumn of the same year. The second layer is local. Before rising, Hou Jing secretly instructed the commanderies of Henan to answer his call; the surrendered households of the Six Garrisons, the Henan magnates and the frontier soldiers had long been taxed and conscripted by Eastern Wei and were waiting for a disturbance to change their colours, so that when the order went out most of the commanderies answered, and the rebel force was not an isolated band but a rising with a local base. The third layer lies on the Liang side. Liang's emperor had failed at northern expeditions for years and needed an insider to prise Henan open, and when Hou Jing's submission arrived Xiao Yan accepted it at once, gave him titles and sent envoys, folding Henan and Hou Jing's soldiers into his own plan. In hindsight that was an expensive bargain; at the court of Jiankang in 547 it looked like a gift handed over.
impact: 對東魏一方，這場叛亂是把柄也是鍛鍊。高澄平叛之後，把河南的軍政整頓得更嚴：地方鎮兵的番代、州郡的兵源都重新編排，避免再出一個擁兵在外的河南行台。可是他在得勝後不到一年就病逝於軍中，弟高洋嗣位，廢魏尊齊，北齊建立——東魏這個短暫的政權名號由此結束。更深的影響在侯景身上：他雖敗於寒山，卻保住了壽陽這個據點和手上的隊伍，於548年高澄死後他立刻反身向南，殺過淮水，最終渡江圍住臺城，把梁武帝逼死宮中，梁朝就此崩潰，史稱侯景之亂。侯景軍中有大量河南與關中降戶及邊軍，這批人隨侯景南下，改變了江淮之間的軍戶結構，也把六鎮降戶的問題從河北帶到了江南；南朝從此元氣大傷，與北朝對立的格局固化，這也為日後隋平定南方埋下了伏筆。
impactEn: For Eastern Wei this rebellion was both a warning and a hardening process. After the suppression Gao Cheng tightened the military government of Henan: the rotation of the local garrison troops and the sources of strength for the prefectures and commanderies were reorganised so that no other Director of Henan with an army outside the capital could arise. Yet less than a year after his victory he died of illness in camp, his brother Gao Yang succeeded him, and the Wei court was replaced by the Qi court, so the short-lived name of Eastern Wei came to an end. The deeper effect lay on Hou Jing himself. Though he was broken at Hanshan, he kept his base at Shouyang and the men in his hands; in 548, as soon as Gao Cheng died, he turned back, drove south of the Huai, and eventually crossed the river and ringed the palace city at Jiankang, where Emperor Wu of Liang was starved to death and the Liang house collapsed in what is called the Hou Jing rebellion. Hou Jing's army carried a large number of Henan and Guanzhong surrendered households and frontier soldiers, and these men marched south with him, changing the military household structure of the Jiang and Huai and carrying the problem of the Six Garrisons' surrendered men from the north into the south. The Southern dynasties were badly weakened by it, the pattern of opposition between north and south hardened, and in this lay a preparation for the eventual pacification of the south by Sui.
result: 就本役的勝負而言，是東魏一方得勝。彭城之圍解除，侯景大軍在寒山崩散，他只帶數十騎退入壽陽，憑城池與殘兵固守；高澄追至城下，築圍城、修長塹，最後雙方定約相見、各自罷兵，河南大部的州郡與倉庫重新回到高氏控制之下。梁朝則同時錯失兩樣東西：一次把勢力楔進河南的良機，和一支本可隨侯景南下的援軍——汝南王蕭淵明的五萬眾在彭城以北崩散，士卒死者以萬計，軍心與國力都為之一挫。勝負之外，這場戰爭還留下兩個尾巴：一是高澄在得勝後不到一年病逝，高洋代立，北齊建立，東魏的名號隨之取消；二是侯景本人，他雖在東魏面前失敗，卻沒有被消滅，反而帶著河南的邊軍人數與糧秣，主動向梁索求兵權、然後渡江，製造了南朝最慘烈的一場內亂，直至552年才被平定。對東魏而言，一場叛亂被壓了下去，卻也把最好的一支邊軍推成了對手的刀；對梁而言，一份送上門的禮物，最後變成了壓垮王朝的重量。
resultEn: As regards the fighting itself, Eastern Wei had the better of it. The siege of Pengcheng was lifted, Hou Jing's army was shattered at Hanshan, and he took only a few tens of horsemen back into Shouyang, holding it with the city and his remnants. Gao Cheng pressed to the walls, built an enclosure and long ditches, and the two sides finally agreed to meet and disband their forces, and the commanderies, depots and cities of the greater part of Henan returned to Gao control. Liang lost two things at once: the opening for pushing a wedge into Henan, and a reinforcement that might have marched south with Hou Jing, for the fifty thousand men the Prince of Runan, Xiao Yuanming, had brought north broke up north of Pengcheng with losses in the tens of thousands, and both morale and resources of the state were shaken by it. Beyond the score, the war left two loose ends. The first was that Gao Cheng died of illness less than a year after his victory, Gao Yang took his place, the Northern Qi was founded, and the name Eastern Wei was retired. The second was Hou Jing himself: defeated before Eastern Wei, he was not destroyed, but carried away the frontier soldiers and the grain of Henan, openly demanded troops and titles from Liang, and then crossed the river, raising the most terrible internal war the Southern dynasty ever knew, which was not put down until 552. For Eastern Wei a rebellion had been suppressed, but the finest frontier army in the realm had been pushed into the hand of the enemy as a knife; for Liang a gift handed over at the gate became the weight that crushed the dynasty.
